title: Unforgettable Honeymoon at Singapore & Malaysia
highlights: Make the time memorable with your partner on your vacation to Singapore and Malaysia, covering attractions and experiences from their famous locations.
Visit the stunning Petronas Twin Towers, the world's tallest twin skyscrapers and admire the beauty of Kuala Lumpur's skyline from its observation deck.
Explore the beautiful Merlion Park and click pictures with your partner in front of the iconic Merlion statue, symbolizing the heritage of Singapore.
Take a walk on the Helix Bridge, an architectural marvel inspired by the structure of DNA and offering stunning views of the Marina Bay skyline.
Enjoy a visit to Sunway Lagoon, a perfect place for adventure seekers and have fun taking on waterslides and amusement rides.
overview:
About the tour:
Relish in the dramatic contrast of modernity meeting the rustic of Singapore and Malaysia. Discover the nuances of both the countries' cultural and artistic evolution on this powerpack vacation to one of the most popular tourist destinations of Southeast Asia.
From the surreal manmade landscapes like the Gardens by the Bay and Universal Studios in Singapore to the tropical treasures of Malaysia like Genting Highlands and Batu Caves, this tour is an experience of a lifetime and will inspire you to explore this diverse continent and witness its magic.


Quick Info:
Destinations Covered: City Tour - Sentosa Island - Kuala Lumpur - Sunway Lagoon - Genting Highlands - Batu Caves
Duration: 7 Days, 6 Nights
Start Point: Changi International Airport (SIN)
End Point: Kuala Lumpur International Airport (KUL)

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Singapore
days.desc: Welcome to Singapore, the Lion City! Upon arrival, get a transfer to your hotel. After checking in, take some time to relax and settle into your room. Later, you can head to the Singapore Zoo for a romantic river safari or enjoy live animal shows with your loved one. Take a hand-in-hand walk on Bukit Batok Hill or relax on Changi Beach together. If you're in the mood for shopping, visit Orchard Road, a retail and dining paradise. Finally, return to your hotel for a cozy overnight stay.

days.title: Singapore Half-Day City Tour
days.desc: Get transferred to explore the landmarks of Singapore, like the Art Science Museum, Esplanade Theater, the iconic Merlion statue and more. Don't forget to snap a picture with your partner! Afterwards, head to Suntec City, Singapore's largest shopping mall with the Fountain of Wealth. Then, take a romantic ride on the Singapore Flyer's observation wheel. Finally, make a stop at Plaza Singapura for some shopping with your partner, before transferring to your hotel for a romantic overnight stay.

days.title: Excursion to Sentosa Island
days.desc: Begin with a transfer for a romantic tour to Sentosa Island. Hop on a cable car ride from the Singapore Cable Car station, which will take you both straight to the island. Once you arrive, visit the Madame Tussauds Wax Museum and capture some lovely moments with the wax figures of your favourite celebrities along with an audition at the new Ultimate Film Star Experience. You can visit Adventure Cove Waterpark at your own expense. Finally, get transferred back to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Arrival in Kuala Lumpur
days.desc: Check-out and get ready for a transfer to the Changi International Airport for your flight to Kuala Lumpur. While you wait for your flight, enjoy the couple massage, swimming pool and more. Upon arrival in Kuala Lumpur, get transferred to your hotel, check-in and relax for a while. In the afternoon, you can head out to explore the KL Bird Park and snap photos with colourful parrots or shop and dine at Petaling Street. Later, head back to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Kuala Lumpur Half day City tour
days.desc: Start your day with a transfer to explore Kuala Lumpur's vibrant beauty. Visit iconic landmarks like the Petronas Twin Towers and walk through unique street markets. Later, head straight to the King's Palace, the National Mosque and the Sultan Abdul Samad Building followed by paying respects at Tugu Negara. End the day, by treating your partner with some chocolates from the Cocoa Boutique. After a long day of exploring, get transferred back to your hotel for a comfortable overnight stay.

days.title: Day Trip to Genting Highland | En route Batu Caves
days.desc: Hop on a transfer for a day trip to Genting Highlands, an ideal place for couples seeking adventure and fun. You can enjoy the dreamy cable car as you ascend to the top of the mountain. Once you arrive, enjoy rides at the indoor and outdoor amusement parks and dine at restaurants. Also, you can try your lady luck at Genting Casino. On your way back, visit Batu Caves, one of the largest Hindu temples dedicated to Lord Murugan. End the day with a transfer back to your hotel for an overnight stay.

Board the flight and treasure the moments you both have spent in this beautiful place, creating memories that will last a lifetime.
